newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RECORD SIGNING COLE MAKES COMEBACK IN RESERVES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RECORD SIGNING COLE MAKES COMEBACK IN RESERVES.

text.p: Andy Cole, Manchester United's record seven million pounds ($11 million) signing from Newcastle, was making his comeback from injury in a reserve match on Monday.
Cole, who missed the start of the season with pneumonia, has not played since breaking his right leg and fracturing a small bone beneath his left knee while playing for the reserves in October.
He has yet to start a first team match this season.
